atoms.name: forward
atoms.rule: Move one cell forward if it is inside the map and is traversable.
atoms.plain: Move one cell forward if it is inside the map and is traversable.
atoms.plain_zh: 如果前方一格在地图内并且能走，就向前走一格。

atoms.name: turn_left
atoms.rule: Turn the robot one quarter turn left.
atoms.plain: Turn the robot one quarter turn left.
atoms.plain_zh: 原地向左转四分之一圈。

atoms.name: turn_right
atoms.rule: Turn the robot one quarter turn right.
atoms.plain: Turn the robot one quarter turn right.
atoms.plain_zh: 原地向右转四分之一圈。

atoms.name: pick
atoms.rule: Pick the top block or tool from the cell directly ahead if the hand is empty.
atoms.plain: Pick the top block or tool from the cell directly ahead if the hand is empty.
atoms.plain_zh: 空手时拿起正前方格子最上面的积木或工具。

atoms.name: place
atoms.rule: Place a held block on the front stack, or use a bridge kit on front water.
atoms.plain: Place a held block on the front stack, or use a bridge kit on front water.
atoms.plain_zh: 把手里的积木放到正前方那一摞的最上面，或把桥梁工具放到正前方的水面上。

atoms.name: craft
atoms.rule: At a front bench, consume its top two recipe colours and make a bridge kit in an empty hand.
atoms.plain: At a front bench, consume its top two recipe colours and make a bridge kit in an empty hand.
atoms.plain_zh: 正前方的工作台最上面两块是配方颜色时，用它们做出一个桥梁工具。

atoms.name: front_wall
atoms.rule: True if the front cell is outside the map or a wall.
atoms.plain: True if the front cell is outside the map or a wall.
atoms.plain_zh: 正前方在地图外或是墙时为真。

atoms.name: front_water
atoms.rule: True if the front cell is water without a bridge.
atoms.plain: True if the front cell is water without a bridge.
atoms.plain_zh: 正前方是没架桥的水面时为真。

atoms.name: front_colour
atoms.rule: The colour of the top front block, or undefined when there is none.
atoms.plain: The colour of the top front block, or undefined when there is none.
atoms.plain_zh: 正前方最上面积木的颜色，没有积木时无定义。

atoms.name: holding
atoms.rule: True if the robot holds a block or tool.
atoms.plain: True if the robot holds a block or tool.
atoms.plain_zh: 机器人手里有积木或工具时为真。

atoms.name: held_colour
atoms.rule: The held block colour, or undefined when no block is held.
atoms.plain: The held block colour, or undefined when no block is held.
atoms.plain_zh: 手里积木的颜色，手里不是积木时无定义。

atoms.name: front_height
atoms.rule: The front stack height, or undefined outside the map.
atoms.plain: The front stack height, or undefined outside the map.
atoms.plain_zh: 正前方那一摞积木的块数，在地图外时无定义。

domain.en: A value is the state of an 8×8 block map: terrain, block stacks, tools, bridges and a robot with a position, a facing and one hand.
domain.zh: 取值是一张 8×8 积木地图的状态：地形、积木堆、工具、桥，以及一个有位置、朝向和一只手的机器人。

settings.en: The map size and the highest allowed stack.
settings.zh: 地图大小和一摞积木允许的最大高度。

settings.en: The actions and observations that skills are grown from.
settings.zh: 生成技能时使用的动作和观察。

why.en: These atoms are one example. Atoms are chosen by the user: any state action or observation with a rule can be registered, and skills grow from it in the same way.
why.zh: 这些原子只是一个例子。原子由用户自己选：任何写得出规则的状态动作或观察都能注册，技能会用同样的方式从它长出来。

operators.name: ★₁
operators.definition: s ★₁ = { turn_right then forward }

operators.plain_zh: 先向右转，再向前走一格。
